RESULT [webresearch]: Across 57 agents of 22 classes, the authors conclude that despite progress on individual parts, 'AI remains far from solving the challenge of science research assistance.'
US [webresearch]: The methodology to copy: fix the tool set (the same literature-search API for every brain), log cost, and compare brains on identical tasks. That is the fair way to test whether an open cluster brain can replace Claude for our research step.
